## Description {#details}

<p>This file defines the RISCVCustomBehaviour class which inherits from CustomBehaviour.</p>


<p>This class is used by the tool llvm-mca to enforce target specific behaviour that is not expressed well enough in the scheduling model for mca to enforce it automatically.</p>
